annotations.title: Compare a plan's price across regions

description: Rank the price of one subscription plan (e.g. ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, Google AI Pro) across countries and regions, converted to one currency. Answers questions like "where is ChatGPT Plus cheapest?" or "how much is Claude Pro in Turkey?". Prices are monthly equivalents; for yearly billing the full-year total is also given. Each response includes when the prices and exchange rates were last updated.

channel.description: Sales channel: web (regional website prices) or app_store (iOS). Defaults to web for ChatGPT and app_store for other products. Claude website reference prices use get_reference_prices.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for converted reference prices, e.g. USD, CNY, EUR. Defaults to USD for en and CNY for zh.

locale.description: Language for region and plan names: en (default) or zh.

plan.description: Plan key from list_catalog, e.g. plus, pro, business (ChatGPT), claude_pro, gemini_ai_pro, perplexity_pro, supergrok. Defaults to the product's main plan.

product.description: Product key returned by list_catalog, including dynamically registered app_<apple-id> products.

region.description: Optional filter by region code, name or currency, e.g. JP, Japan, 日本, EUR.

sort.description: asc: cheapest first (default); desc: most expensive first; name: alphabetical.

tax.description: Only regions whose reference price has this tax label.

name: compare_prices

localAmount.description: Reference price in the local currency for the billing interval; App Store yearly amounts are full-year totals.

referencePrice.description: Monthly-equivalent reference price converted to the requested currency.

vsUs.description: Percent difference from the United States reference price.

yearlyTotal.description: Full-year reference amount in the requested currency (yearly billing only).

title: Compare a plan's price across regions
